He poured his tea, mended the wick, and kept the promise his family had always kept.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还沉在深蓝里。街灯一盏盏亮着，照着空无一人的马路。偶尔有早班的公交驶过，轮胎碾过湿漉漉的柏油。便利店的灯是暖黄的，店员靠在柜台打盹。远处传来扫街的沙沙声，环卫工的背影弯着。天边有一点淡淡的灰白，像是黎明在试探。这座城市还没醒，却已经有人悄悄为它上了发条。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a problem by doing a smaller version of the same problem.\n• It keeps shrinking the problem until it reaches a tiny case so easy you just know the answer.\n• Like looking inside nested boxes: open one, find a smaller box, repeat until you reach the box with the prize."}
